title: Proposed invariants — concepts that may be dimensionless: meaning that could outlast time and supersede human experience
note: These are CLAIMS, not findings — the strongest claims the framework holds, and the least attestable. Each is a concept proposed as *dimensionless*: invariant across every dimension (conveyance, culture, time, depth), grounded in a domain that holds independent of any mind to think it. The framework measures each candidate's INVARIANCE across the record (the dimensions it can attest) and reports it as a PROXY for universality — never a proof. Two kinds: an `a-priori` invariant is presupposed by the record, never recorded in it (logic, information — the distinction, identity, truth); it is the most dimensionless and the least witnessable. A `manifest` invariant is demonstrably held across the record's own span (a breath value that crosses the threshold into pump words); the record can show how long it has lasted, but not that it outlasts time. `grounding` names why the concept may supersede human experience; `domains` the extra-human fields it holds in; `migrates_as` / `sign` link a manifest invariant to its measured corpus footprint. The one gap the framework cannot measure is the distance between 'invariant across all we can attest' and 'true universal truth' — because the record is itself within time.

invariants.name: the distinction (0/1)
invariants.gloss: that there is a difference at all — one bit
invariants.grounding: information: a distinction is the irreducible unit of information, prior to any mind to draw it; natural computing reads 0 or 1 before any meaning is condensed on it

invariants.name: identity (A is A)
invariants.grounding: logic: identity holds in every possible world, presupposed by any act of reference whatsoever

invariants.name: truth
invariants.gloss: what holds, against what does not
invariants.grounding: logic: the truth of a proposition is independent of any belief in it — it is the direction the whole framework points at

invariants.name: unity / oneness
invariants.grounding: mathematics: the unit — the one — is presupposed by counting itself, prior to anything counted

invariants.name: equilibrium / balance
invariants.grounding: physics: a closed system tends toward equilibrium regardless of any observer

invariants.name: recurrence / the cycle
invariants.gloss: the eternal return, the closed loop
invariants.grounding: mathematics and cosmology: periodicity and conservation hold without mind — the circle has no beginning
